p: The Packers want to involve the tight ends more in the passing game.
LaFleur flagged tight ends and backs as an area to 'amp up', which could mean more targets, though he named no player.
We got to get our tight ends and backs involved.
Kraft will be used more downfield and in different ways in the passing game, with his snaps still managed.
He is trusted as a core piece and was extended, and his snap cap is likely to loosen as he gets healthier. That makes him a rising TE option.
Any way you can get that guy the ball the better.
Kraft was capped at about 40 snaps in his first game back and played 45 without being gassed.
His snap count may stay limited in the short term, but he looks healthy and in shape.
We were going to cap him at 40.
